result.summary:
REQ-VALIDATOR, WF-03 step 02b for ISS-0002. Verdict: FAIL. One blocking finding (F1, MEDIUM) in REQ-002 criterion 11. All other checks pass. Route: back to REQ-ANALYST (rework 1), criterion 11 only. Fold F2-F4 (LOW) into the same edit. The bar is not lowered anywhere, the attribution is faithful, and the two clauses the analyst flagged stay (rulings below). I did not edit docs/requirements.yaml. I extracted REQ-002 by its id from a snapshot taken 2026-10-01T01:32:44Z, whose sha256 4fe2c96e...6b3 equals the analyst's AFTER hash.

FINDINGS

F1 - MEDIUM, blocking. Checks (a) testability and (b) consistency.
Location: docs/requirements.yaml, REQ-002, acceptance_criteria[10] (criterion 11), opening clause: «других ошибок из критериев 3, 4, 6, 7 нет ... у prepare-run папку прогона (и runs/, если её нет): цель — папка, ссылка или не обычный файл».
Problem:
- For prepare-run the target is the run folder. So «цель — ссылка» and «не обычный файл» cover a link (even a broken one) or a fifo/socket at runs/<RUN-ID>, and for those the criterion demands exit 1 and E_WRITE.
- Design v4 says otherwise. §4.1 and the §6 E_USAGE row give E_USAGE, exit 2, for ANY entry at that path. Row P12 (broken link → `E_USAGE: run folder already exists: runs/WF06-20260925-01`, code 2) is in tools/test/prepare.write.test.js, one of the three files criterion 11's own check command runs.
- The precondition does not remove the case. Criterion 4 names only «уже существующая папка», and its test (tools/test/prepare.test.js:75-82) uses a real folder. Criterion 3 covers §6 «нарушения» with exit 1, and §6 classes E_USAGE as a usage error with exit 2.
- The other way to read the precondition is by the error the command prints, not by the input. That would let any write obstacle reported as E_USAGE escape criterion 11.
- So for P12's input the criterion gives exit 1 under one reading and exit 2 under the other. It cannot decide the case, and it contradicts the design.
- The analyst's open item 3 records that criterion 4 is narrower than §4.1/P12. ORCH ruled on criterion 4 vs the design, not on criterion 11 vs P12.
Fix, option A (preferred; stays inside criterion 11, criterion 4 untouched). Make the precondition input-based, carve the case out, and restrict the first kind to apply-verdict. For example: «Сбой записи (ISS-0002): других ошибок из критериев 3, 4, 6, 7 нет, у prepare-run по пути папки прогона нет никакой записи — любая запись там, даже битая ссылка, — это E_USAGE, код 2 (дизайн §4.1, P12), — но apply-verdict или prepare-run не может записать свои цели — у apply-verdict STATE.md, apply-report.json и при ACCEPT proposed-actions.json, у prepare-run папку прогона (и runs/, если её нет): цель apply-verdict — папка, ссылка или не обычный файл; ...».
Fix, option B. ORCH amends criterion 4 to «по пути папки прогона при prepare-run уже есть запись (папка, файл, ссылка, даже битая)» and re-verifies it (P12, prepare.test.js). That is stricter, so it is allowed, but it changes a done criterion.
Optional in the same edit: say that criterion 4's «папка вне runs/» is judged by the path, without following links (cli.js:40-49 is lexical). Then W13 (<R> is a link to a folder outside the project) stays in criterion 11 under any reading.

F2 - LOW, precision.
Location: the coverage clause «есть тесты на каждый вид сбоя из списка».
Problem: some list items have alternatives. Read loosely, W06 alone could count for the whole first item, which would leave the fifo case untested.
Fix: «... на каждый вид сбоя из списка, а у вида с вариантами — на каждый вариант, возможный у команды (у apply-verdict: цель — папка, ссылка, не обычный файл; на пути — ссылка; у prepare-run: на пути — ссылка и файл)».

F3 - LOW, precision.
Location: convergence, «повторный запуск даёт те же байты целей, что запуск без сбоя».
Problem: prepare-run's run.json holds created_at from the clock unless --created-at is given (prepare.js:28, cli.js:71). Without the same --created-at the bytes cannot match.
Fix: «повторный запуск с теми же аргументами (у prepare-run — с тем же --created-at) даёт те же байты целей, что запуск без сбоя».

F4 - LOW, precision.
Location: exception «сбой уборки после применения».
Problem: unlike the double-fault exception, it does not say that everything else stays as before. W46 expects «других изменений нет».
Fix: add «, остальное как до запуска».

RULINGS ON THE TWO CLAUSES THE ANALYST FLAGGED
Both stay in criterion 11. The gap is in design v4 §9, not in the requirement. Narrowing the criterion to match the design would lower Q5. ORCH routes both to CODE-DESIGNER via CODE-DESIGN-VALIDATOR, which should not pass v4 against criterion 11 without these rows.

(a) A target that is not a regular file.
- The design already promises the behavior (§5.3 W1.2; §5.6 EINVAL «is not a regular file»; §6), but §9.4 has no test row for it.
- Testable. Probe on this Mac: mkfifo at <R>/apply-report.json, and lstat sees a fifo. Pre-fix code had already rewritten STATE.md and created proposed-actions.json, then hung reading the fifo; the spawnSync timeout stopped it (ETIMEDOUT, 4006 ms).
- A unix socket at the same path: pre-fix exit 1, 8 stack lines, errno -102, STATE.md already changed. The absolute fixture path is 174 bytes, over the macOS 104-byte socket path limit, so a socket test must listen via chdir and a relative name.
- Design fix: add a W row. For example: RF, <R>/apply-report.json is a fifo → `E_WRITE <R>/apply-report.json: is not a regular file (EINVAL); nothing was changed`, with a spawnSync timeout so the pre-fix run fails instead of hanging. Add a mutant «W1.4 before W1.2» that this row must kill. A socket row is optional (same branch).

(b) SIGKILL for prepare-run.
- §4.1 sends prepare-run through §5.2, whose interruption guarantee covers every target, and D1 says interruption is checked by a test. §9.5 has no such row, which is a Q3/Q5 gap in the design.
- Testable. Probe: an --import preload wrote half of run.json, then sent SIGKILL. Pre-fix code left runs/WF06-20260925-01/ with run.json at 517 of 1035 bytes, so the test tells fixed code from unfixed code.
- Design fix: add P13. Setup: runs/ present; fault: writeFileSync of run.json inside runs/.WF06-20260925-01.sai-tmp/, partial-kill. Checks: K1; K2 <R> absent; K3 the next prepare-run exits 1 with empty stdout and exactly `E_WRITE <R>: leftover runs/.WF06-20260925-01.sai-tmp ...`, no stack trace, tree unchanged by that run; K4 then A6. Optionally P14: renameSync of the temp folder to <R>, kill.

DEVIATIONS FROM THE §12 TEXT
1. Precondition «no other errors from criteria 3, 4, 6, 7». Needed (criterion 7: W18 and cli.test.js:187 «STATE.md that is a folder»; criterion 4: an existing folder) but incomplete → F1.
2. Read-only counts only when a target must change, or must change or be created in that folder. Correct: matches controls W22 and W27 and refusals W19-W21, W24-W26, W28, W29, P05.
3. The two named exceptions (double fault; cleanup failure after the apply). Correct, and not a lowering.
   - Both are failures of the cleanup itself. No implementation can then leave the listing unchanged, so §12's unconditional «не меняется» would be a false claim (Q3).
   - The criterion keeps everything else as before and requires every leftover to be named. It keeps exit 1, empty stdout and E_WRITE-only stderr.
   - The design's tests still compare the exact tree: A5 becomes «before + the named entries» in W44, W45, W46 and P11.
   - The leftovers block the next run until they are removed (§5.5).
   - Only F4 is missing.
4. «Ничего не пишет вне проекта». Correct (Q11): W11, W13 and P04 compare the outside target through tree(root, extra).
5. proposed-actions.json is a target only on ACCEPT. Correct (criterion 9; W03, W09, W25, W33, W43).
6. SIGKILL with «если в STATE.md новое, то и в остальных», convergence, empty stdout. Correct (§5.2; W47, W48; A2, A6, K4). The byte-based convergence wording is more accurate than §5.2 item 3 («applied, затем unchanged»), which is wrong for W15 and W46.
7. Check = the three test files §9 names, listing.test.js included. Correct. «эти файлы входят в npm run check» holds: the package.json test script is node --test "test/**/*.test.js".
Also correct, though missing from §12: «любая ошибка ОС на любом шаге записи» (matches §5.2 and §6: chmod, link, lstat, cleanup) and «существующую цель нельзя прочитать для сравнения» (W1.4; W16, W17).

OTHER CHECKS
- Consistency with criteria 3, 6, 7, 9 (beyond F1).
  - Criterion 11 is stricter than criteria 6 and 7 (strict listing vs a path+hash list) and applies only after their checks pass.
  - It keeps criterion 9: no proposed-actions.json in escalate mode.
  - STATE.md is read with statSync (util.js:55-62). So a STATE.md link to a regular file reaches the write phase (W12, E_WRITE ELOOP), while a fifo or unreadable STATE.md stays in criterion 7 (E_STATE_ANCHOR). Consistent.
  - Design LOW: v4 §6 makes E_WRITE a prepare-run «нарушение», so criterion 3 now also needs an E_WRITE test for prepare-run. The §9 row for criterion 3 should name prepare.write.test.js.
- depends_on [] is correct.
- Stage fit: REQ-002 has no stage field; this is a tools-only fix inside REQ-002. Fine.
- Size: one cohesive deliverable (same helpers, same guarantee; AP-014 asks to fix the class together). Fine.
- Attribution: faithful.
  - ISS-0002: found by BACKEND-DEV while fixing ISS-0001; confirmed and widened by REVIEWER (I1).
  - step-01-issue-fixer.json: M2 «(not in the issue)» and the prepare-run gap (SIBLINGS, §4.1, real ENOSPC reproduced on HFS+).
  - The text is based on design v4 §12 Q1.
  - Nothing is attributed to the owner, and original_request is byte-identical to the pre-ISS-0002 copy. There is no independent copy of the owner's message in sai/: grep finds it only in requirements.yaml. It was validated with REQ-002 before.
- No bar lowering anywhere in the text.
  - Folder mtime is not compared because temp+rename must change it, and the listing is still stricter than before.
  - Power loss is not claimed (Q3).
  - Q8 and R3 are not touched. For Q10, this criterion is the failure criterion.
- Edit scope verified independently. The REQ-002 block in the ISS-0001 reviewer's pre-ISS-0002 copy (scratchpad rev-iss0001/base/docs/requirements.yaml) is 32 lines, 0b405f3d..., equal to the analyst's BEFORE. The diff to the live block is 21a22,27 (description) and 32a39 (criterion 11), with 0 deleted lines.

OBSERVATIONS FOR ORCH (not requirement-text defects)
- Q14: REQ-002 still says «status: done # RELEASE-VALIDATOR PASS 2026-09-28», but criterion 11's check command exits 1 today («Could not find 'test/apply.write.test.js, test/prepare.write.test.js, test/listing.test.js'»). Your planned flip to in_progress must land before any implementation step.
